scope: Frozen Panthera MuJoCo and offline results. Public summary and selected curve data; original complete records are not bundled. Metrics apply to each declared experiment.

control.scope: descriptive results for this fixed MuJoCo model and configuration; not a universal controller ranking and not real-robot evidence

adaptive.scope: Single payload mass is adapted; payload COM and unit-mass inertia are known. Same feedback and reference across paired controllers; not full inertial identification.

tall_obstacles.scope: One fixed seven-obstacle scene, 14-21 cm tall, two predeclared planner seeds, 6 mm query margin.

visual_execution.scope: Known marker geometry, simulated RGB-D, same-exposure robot pose, known obstacle map, fixed observation pose; no real D405 or continuous visual-servo claim.

grid.scope: Deterministic 10x10 position grid, nominal model, known object poses; one execution per case. No random generalization, vision, learning or real-robot claim.

ppo.scope: Equal task completion across all three groups does not establish a learning benefit.

source.plotted_values: Original samples, without smoothing; include the last original point.

observer.scope: Conditional interval for filtered torque under declared friction bounds; not physical collision detection.

gripper_force.scope: Per-finger mean normal force in two fixed steady windows, noiseless supported object simulation.

robotics_chain.svg: conceptual module relationship; no experimental data
learning_chain.svg: conceptual model and evaluation relationship; no experimental data
